description: Fetches award winners and technical paper awards from the ACM SIGGRAPH Blog (blog.siggraph.org), including Best Papers, Honorable Mentions, Test-of-Time awards, and conference award winners across categories like Art Gallery, Electronic Theater, Emerging Technologies, and more.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_award_winners: 获取SIGGRAPH会议获奖者列表，包括Art Gallery、Electronic Theater、Emerging Technologies等类别的奖项; 参数: url, year; 必填: 无
  - get_technical_papers: 获取SIGGRAPH技术论文奖项，包括Best Papers、Honorable Mentions、Test-of-Time Awards; 参数: url, year; 必填: 无
  - search_posts: 在SIGGRAPH博客中搜索文章; 参数: query; 必填: query

url.description: 指定要获取的博客文章URL。如未提供，将使用默认URL（用于get_award_winners和get_technical_papers）

year.description: 筛选年份（如"2024"）。用于构造默认URL
